description: Tasks template for modernization plan. Generate this file alongside plan.md to track individual migration tasks.

tasks.description: Migrate the Oracle JDBC data source, JPA dialect, SQL syntax, and schema definitions to Azure Database for PostgreSQL, including converting photo BLOB storage to PostgreSQL bytea.
tasks.reason: The application currently uses Oracle Database with Oracle-specific JDBC driver, OracleDialect, and BLOB data types. Azure Database for PostgreSQL is the target managed relational database service on Azure, eliminating the need for self-managed Oracle infrastructure.
tasks.requirements: Replace the Oracle data source and JDBC driver with PostgreSQL equivalents. Update Spring datasource configuration and Hibernate dialect for Azure Database for PostgreSQL, and update schema definitions and any Oracle-specific repository SQL to PostgreSQL-compatible forms. Convert photo BLOB storage to PostgreSQL bytea. Configure the PostgreSQL endpoint and managed identity authentication, replacing the current plaintext database credentials.
